account.title: Account settings

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and remove your saved data. Your past comments stay public but are no longer linked to you.
deleteAccount.confirm: This will permanently delete your account. You can't undo this. Continue?
deleteAccount.failed: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.

account.seoDesc: Manage your reader account: display name, password, and push devices.
account.loadFailed: Couldn't load this list — please check your connection
account.signInPrompt: Sign in to manage your account settings

profile.title: Profile
profile.bioPlaceholder: A sentence or two about yourself, shown on your public profile…
profile.bioHint: Plain text shown on your profile page; leave empty to remove.
profile.avatarFailed: Couldn't update picture — please try again
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB
profile.publicLikesLabel: Show my liked posts on my public profile
profile.publicLikesHint: Publish a "Liked posts" tab on your public profile page so other readers can discover the posts you appreciate. Off by default — your likes stay private until you switch this on.
profile.publicBmarksLabel: Show my saved posts on my public profile
profile.publicBmarksHint: Publish a "Saved posts" tab on your public profile page so other readers can discover the posts you chose to keep. Off by default — your bookmarks stay private until you switch this on.

email.title: Change sign-in email
email.note: Switching to a new address is a two-step change: request a link here, then open the link we email to the new address.
email.success: Verification link sent — check the new address's inbox and open it within 60 minutes (your current email keeps working until you do).
email.taken: That email is already used by another account
email.same: That's already your current email — pick an address you want to switch to
email.failed: Couldn't send the link — please try again

password.title: Change password
password.tooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
password.success: Password changed — other devices have been signed out
password.failed: Couldn't change the password — please try again

devices.title: Push devices
devices.empty: No push devices are linked to this account
devices.revokeConfirm: Remove this device? It will stop receiving notifications from your account.
devices.revokeFailed: Couldn't remove the device — please try again
devices.note: Browsers that subscribed to Web Push while signed in appear here.
devices.newPostsNote: Push this device when a new post is published.
devices.categoriesLoadFailed: Couldn't load categories — filter options may be missing.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.note: Extra protection for your account: with 2FA on, every login asks for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…), or enter the secret below manually.
twoFactor.enableCodeLabel: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator
twoFactor.offHint: Turn on two-factor authentication to require a code from your authenticator app at every sign-in.
twoFactor.setupFailed: Couldn't start enrollment — check your connection and try again.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code isn't right. Enter the current 6-digit code displayed in your authenticator app.
twoFactor.disableFailed: Couldn't turn off 2FA — check your password and code and try again.
twoFactor.enablePasswordHint: Your password is required to enable 2FA — so a stolen session alone can't lock you out.
